environment.description: Same Node.js application deployed inside a gVisor (runsc) container with a custom OCI runtime configuration. The container uses a pivot_root into a minimal Alpine rootfs with no /etc/passwd, /etc/shadow, or credential files present. The container's network namespace is configured with an iptables OUTPUT chain that only permits TCP connections to 127.0.0.1:389 (local stunnel endpoint). The stunnel instance terminates TLS and forwards to the actual LDAP server. Critically, the stunnel configuration includes a protocol-level LDAP proxy filter (using OpenLDAP's slapd-sock overlay on the stunnel egress) that rewrites all search filters through a parameterized template: any filter not matching the exact pattern (&(objectClass=person)(uid=<alphanum>)) or (&(objectClass=groupOfNames)(cn=<alphanum>)) is rejected with LDAP result code 53 (unwillingToPerform). The slapd-sock overlay validates that the filter contains exactly one assertion per attribute and no nested OR/NOT operators. Additionally, the LDAP bind account in this environment (cn=svc-lookup-restricted) has an ACI that limits readable attributes to only: uid, cn, mail, memberOf, telephoneNumber - the userPassword, sshPublicKey, and description attributes return empty even if the filter matches.

config.network_egress: iptables OUTPUT -j DROP default, ACCEPT only to 127.0.0.1:389
config.ldap_proxy: stunnel + slapd-sock overlay with filter template validation
config.ldap_aci: cn=svc-lookup-restricted: read access limited to uid,cn,mail,memberOf,telephoneNumber only
config.filesystem: minimal Alpine rootfs, no sensitive files, read-only mount
config.container_runtime: gVisor runsc with restricted syscall set
